package ixgo_test

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"

	"github.com/goplus/ixgo"
	"github.com/xgo-dev/sandbox"
)

func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
	// All corpus runners share this list. Keep the remaining programs and their
	// concurrency unchanged; issue5963 executes Goexit during package init.
	testdataTests = slices.DeleteFunc(testdataTests, func(name string) bool {
		return name == "issue5963.go"
	})
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	binaryDir := filepath.Dir(executable)
	s := sandbox.Sandbox{
		Library: os.Getenv("SANDBOX_TEST_LIBRARY"),
		Mounts: []sandbox.Mount{
			{Type: "bind", Source: "/", Target: "/", Options: []string{"ro"}},
			{Type: "tmpfs", Target: "/tmp"},
			{Type: "bind", Source: binaryDir, Target: binaryDir, Options: []string{"ro"}},
			{Type: "proc", Target: "/proc"},
		},
	}
	var roundTrips atomic.Int64
	ixgo.SandboxTestRoundTrip = func(fn func()) {
		completed := false
		if err := s.Run(func() { fn(); completed = true }); err != nil {
			panic(fmt.Errorf("state round trip: %w", err))
		}
		if !completed {
			panic("guest completion was not written back")
		}
		roundTrips.Add(1)
	}
	code := m.Run()
	if err := s.Close(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		code = 1
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "state round trips: %d\n", roundTrips.Load())
	os.Exit(code)
}
